title: Studio on Rent in Gurgaon: 2026 Guide for Creators & Brands

children.text: Gurugram has quietly become one of Delhi NCR's strongest studio markets. Here's what a studio on rent in Gurgaon actually costs in 2026, the areas worth booking, and how to match the space to your shoot.

layout.content: Studio on Rent in Gurgaon: 2026 Guide for Creators & Brands

Searching for a studio on rent in Gurgaon usually means one of two things: you're a creator who's outgrown shooting reels at home, or you're a brand based near Cyber City that needs a reliable space for product, fashion, or ad shoots without a long commute to Delhi. Gurugram has quietly become one of Delhi NCR's strongest studio markets, driven by the density of D2C brands, agencies, and YouTubers already working along the Golf Course Road and Cyber Hub corridor. This guide covers what studios in Gurugram actually cost in 2026, which areas are worth booking in, what separates a studio built for creators from one built for weddings, and how to pick the right space for reels, podcasts, or product shoots without wasting a paid slot.
Why Gurugram Has Become a Content Creation Hub

Gurugram's studio demand didn't come from photographers first — it came from business. The city hosts a dense cluster of D2C brand headquarters, marketing agencies, and startup offices, all of which need product shots, founder interviews, and ad creatives on a recurring basis. That corporate base created steady weekday demand, which in turn made it viable for studios to open closer to Cyber City and Golf Course Road instead of only in Delhi. Add a growing base of YouTubers and podcasters who live in Gurugram's residential sectors, and the result is a studio market that's smaller than South Delhi's but often more convenient if your work or home base is already in the city.
Typical Studio Rental Prices in Gurugram (2026)
Treat these as planning ranges, not quotes — the same studio can charge differently for a personal shoot versus a commercial brand shoot, or on weekends versus weekday mornings.

items: Bare shooting space (natural light, no gear): roughly ₹500-1,000 per hour
Standard equipped studio (strobes or LEDs, 2-3 backdrops): roughly ₹800-1,800 per hour
Multi-set creative studio (3+ dressed sets for reels and product work): roughly ₹1,200-2,500 per hour
Podcast or video-podcast studio (soundproofed, mics, multi-camera setup): roughly ₹1,500-3,000 per hour
Full-day bookings (8 hours) typically run 20-30% cheaper than the equivalent hourly rate

layout.content: In practice, Gurugram studios tend to sit close to Noida on price and below premium South Delhi pockets like Hauz Khas or Shahpur Jat, with the exception of addresses right on Golf Course Road or inside Cyber Hub, which command a premium comparable to South Delhi. As with any city, the address is part of what you're paying for — the same lighting kit costs the same everywhere, but the location adds a real premium.
Best Areas to Book a Studio in Gurugram
Gurugram's studio scene is spread across a few distinct pockets, each suited to a different kind of shoot.

items: DLF Cyber City / Cyber Hub — best for corporate content: founder interviews, talking-head videos, and brand shoots for teams already working in the area
Sushant Lok & Sushant Lok 2 — a creator-friendly pocket with easier parking and quick access from NH-48, popular for podcast and photo studios
Golf Course Road & Golf Course Extension Road — the premium end of the market, with larger multi-set studios suited to fashion and high-end brand shoots
Sector 29 / MG Road — well connected by metro (IFFCO Chowk and Sikanderpur stations), convenient for evening and after-work shoots
Udyog Vihar — larger, more industrial-style production spaces with the floor area needed for bigger video and ad shoots

layout.content: Matching the Studio to Your Shoot Type
Not every Gurugram studio suits every shoot, and the wrong match wastes both time and money on the day.

items: Reels and social content: look for a multi-set studio so you can batch several looks in one booking
Product or catalogue shoots: a cyclorama wall or clean white backdrop with consistent lighting matters more than decor
Podcasts: prioritise soundproofing and an existing video-podcast rig over a studio that only has audio gear
Corporate or interview content: a talking-head setup with a teleprompter and clean background saves the most editing time
Fashion or pre-wedding shoots: natural light and a styling area matter more than equipment variety

layout.content: Golf Course Road and Cyber Hub see the heaviest traffic between 9-11 AM and 6-8 PM. Booking a mid-morning-to-afternoon slot instead of squeezing a shoot around office hours usually gets you more usable time per booking, not just an easier commute.
What to Check Before You Book

items: Confirm exact inclusions (lights, backdrops, props, mics) in writing so you're not renting gear twice
Ask about power backup — a studio without one can lose a shoot to an outage mid-session
Check parking and lift access if you're carrying heavy gear, especially in older Udyog Vihar and Sushant Lok buildings
Get the overtime rate and cancellation window upfront; these two clauses cause most post-shoot disputes
For commercial shoots, confirm whether the studio's rate card differs for brand versus personal use

layout.content: FAQs: Studio Rental in Gurgaon
Is Gurgaon cheaper than Delhi for studio rentals?

It depends on the area. Studios in Sushant Lok, Udyog Vihar, or Sector 29 are often priced close to or slightly below equivalent South Delhi studios. Addresses directly on Golf Course Road or inside Cyber Hub, however, carry a premium similar to Delhi's top neighbourhoods — you're paying for the corporate address as much as the equipment.
Which part of Gurugram is best for podcast recording?

Sushant Lok and the Cyber City corridor have the highest concentration of dedicated podcast and video-podcast studios, largely because of demand from founders and marketing teams based nearby. Confirm soundproofing and camera setup specifically — some studios market themselves as podcast-ready but only offer basic audio recording.
Do Gurgaon studios provide a photographer or crew?

Most studio bookings cover the space and listed equipment only — you bring your own photographer, videographer, or podcast host. Some studios offer an in-house operator or assistant as a paid add-on; confirm their rate and check a portfolio before booking if you need one.
Is parking available near Golf Course Road and Cyber Hub studios?

Most commercial buildings in these areas have paid basement parking, but it fills up quickly during office hours. If you're shooting on a weekday, arrive at least 15-20 minutes early to park, or ask the studio about visitor parking arrangements when you book.
What is the minimum booking duration for a studio in Gurgaon?

Most studios book in 1-hour slots with a 1-2 hour minimum, though premium multi-set and production spaces sometimes require a half-day (4-5 hour) minimum. If you only need a short slot, creator-focused studios in Sushant Lok and Sector 29 are generally more flexible than larger production spaces.

Final Takeaways

A studio on rent in Gurgaon can cost anywhere from ₹500 to ₹3,000 an hour depending on equipment and address, with Sushant Lok, Sector 29, and Udyog Vihar generally offering better value than premium Golf Course Road addresses. Match the studio to the shoot, book off-peak, and confirm inclusions before you pay.

items: Pick your area based on shoot type, not just proximity to your office
Budget ₹800-2,500 per hour for a solidly equipped studio outside the premium pockets
Book mid-morning to afternoon slots to avoid Cyber Hub and Golf Course Road traffic
Get equipment inclusions, overtime rate, and cancellation terms in writing
